tokenize_ir_code: tokenize IR intermediate representation code into a list of whitespace-separated tokens
detokenize_ir_code: detokenize a list of IR tokens back into the original source code string
create_ir_processor: create an IRProcessor instance to tokenize and detokenize IR language code
review_ir_tokenizer: review the IRProcessor tokenize_code method to understand how newlines and whitespace are normalized
summarize_ir_processor_class: summarize the IRProcessor class which extends LangProcessor for IR language tokenization
